key_insight: The paper replaces standard Gauss-law constraints in Abelian Z_N lattice gauge theories (with N a power of two) with a new set of equivalent binary Gauss stabilizers that directly define the gauge-invariant subspace.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical way to build quantum error-correcting codes and gauge-fixing schemes from lattice gauge symmetries without adding extra qubits.
method: Construct an alternative stabilizer group for the gauge-invariant sector of Z_N lattice gauge theories.
Use the binary stabilizers to encode error-correcting codes that exploit existing gauge degrees of freedom.
Propose a new gauge-fixing strategy that removes redundancies and may outperform axial-gauge approaches.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a theoretical construction and application framework, but does not provide quantitative benchmark data or simulation results.
watch_item: The approach is currently described for Abelian Z_N theories with N restricted to powers of two, so generalization beyond this setting may require new ideas.
paper_title: Binary Gauss Stabilizers for Abelian Lattice Gauge Theories
